compiled_state.title: test_runner_smoke.py: cycle-2 deep-tier multi-agent partial-failure -> no test coverage
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 01af4c268a90f1e99f254e386e916dede56a84c5
* **Context Scope:** repo branch `claude/address-pr-79-comments-pAYj3`; bug also present on PR #79 head `eba1de0`. Affected files: `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py`, `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py`.

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick

#### Expected Behavior

Per the project's review-coverage practice (and as flagged by the LLM review runner on PR #79, finding 3/3 at https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/79#issuecomment-4413531036), each independently-reachable code path in `dso_ci_review.runner` that combines cycle-2 defense lookup, deep-tier multi-agent dispatch, and partial agent failure should have at least one regression test.

The cycle-2 path runs `dispatch_two_call_review` (with PR defenses injected) per agent. For deep tier this fans out to 3+ specialist agents (correctness, verification, hygiene) plus arch synthesis, so a single agent hitting `ContextWindowExceededError` and emitting a `fallback_exhausted` sentinel must be merged correctly with the other agents' real findings via `dispatch_arch_synthesis`, after which `_suppress_defended_findings` should still apply.

#### Actual Behavior

`tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py` covers each axis individually but never the combined scenario:

* `test_runner_pipeline_deep_tier_dispatches_three_agents` (line 335) — deep tier dispatch (cycle-1, no partial failure)
* `test_runner_exits_1_when_all_agents_hit_context_window` (line 736) — deep tier, ALL agents exhausted (cycle-1)
* `test_runner_partial_post_failure_continues_remaining_findings` (line 1119) — partial failure (not deep + cycle-2)
* `test_deep_tier_runs_arch_synthesis_after_specialists` (line 1640) — deep tier + arch synthesis (cycle-1, no partial failure)
* `test_runner_cycle2_with_defenses_suppresses_reemitted_findings` (line 1880) — cycle-2 + defenses (standard tier, single-agent two-call path)
* `test_runner_cycle1_no_defenses_unaffected` (line 1948) — cycle-1 baseline

No test combines: cycle-2 + deep tier + at least one specialist returning `fallback_exhausted` + others returning real findings + arch synthesis merge + defense suppression filter.

A regression in the merged-findings → suppression handoff on this path would not be caught by the existing suite.

### 7. Additional Details

* **LLM review category:** verification, severity = important (per `dso_ci_review.runner` output on PR 79 commit `eba1de0`)
* **Suggested test outline (verbatim from reviewer):** "test with deep tier, one agent returning fallback_exhausted, others returning real findings; verify merged findings are correctly passed to arch synthesis and suppression filter applies."
* **Proposed test name:** `test_runner_cycle2_deep_tier_partial_failure_with_defenses` (mirror the cycle-2 standard-tier test naming)
* **Ticket origin:** PR 79 LLM review run https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/25610003123/job/75178907029, comment id 4413531036

comments.body: Upstream-cause status: commit 729d2c2 lands the `review.minor_findings_create_tickets` gate (default: false; opt-in via dso-config.conf). REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md post-pass inspection now consults the gate before auto-filing minor / suggestion findings as bug tickets. The gate prevents NEW tickets of this shape from being auto-created, but does NOT close this ticket — the underlying condition described above persists in the codebase. Close manually if no longer worth tracking.
